name: Media Player Classic PS5
description: Native PS5 homebrew media player inspired by Media Player Classic Home Cinema. Plays local, USB, SMB and network media through FFmpeg, with hardware decoding for H.264 and HEVC up to 4K, HDR10 and HLG tone mapping, 5.1 and 7.1 audio output, software decoding for additional codecs and built-in update checking.
author: MisterTemaki
